title: CliQ-RRG: Clinical-Knowledge Guided Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment for QA-Style Radiology Report Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13059v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Radiology reports are essential for diagnostic reasoning and patient care, yet their manual preparation is time-consuming and cognitively demanding. Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) offers a scalable alternative, but existing models often produce lengthy, unstructured narratives that overlook diagnostic cues and multi-view information. We present Clinical-Knowledge Guided Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment for QA-Style Radiology Report Generation (CliQ-RRG), a unified two-stage framework for interpretable and clinically grounded reporting. In Stage 1, CliQ-RRG employs a Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment module that aligns image and text representations using predicted disease embeddings, reinforced by a Prior-Guided Attention Module (PrAM) to capture multi-view dependencies across current and prior scans. translated_title: CliQ-RRG：临床知识引导的疾病感知视觉-文本对齐用于问答式放射报告生成
translated_abstract: 放射报告对于诊断推理和患者护理至关重要，然而其人工撰写既耗时又对认知能力要求很高。自动放射报告生成（RRG）提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但现有模型往往生成冗长、非结构化的叙述，忽略了诊断线索和多视图信息。我们提出了CliQ-RRG（临床知识引导的疾病感知视觉-文本对齐问答式放射报告生成），这是一个用于可解释且临床可靠的报告生成的统一两阶段框架。在第一阶段，CliQ-RRG采用疾病感知视觉-文本对齐模块，利用预测的疾病嵌入对齐图像和文本表示，并通过先验引导注意力模块（PrAM）来捕获当前扫描与既往扫描之间的多视图依赖关系。在第二阶段，GraphRAG引导的检索通过基于图的临床知识来增强中间文本表示……
tldr: CliQ-RRG提出了一种两阶段框架，通过疾病感知的视觉-文本对齐与先验引导注意力捕获多视图依赖，并利用GraphRAG检索临床知识进行增强，从而生成可解释且符合临床实际的问答式放射报告。
en_tdlr: CliQ-RRG introduces a two-stage framework that combines disease-aware visual-textual alignment with prior-guided attention to capture multi-view dependencies, and leverages GraphRAG-guided clinical knowledge retrieval to generate interpretable and clinically grounded QA-style radiology reports.
